comment: Every herdr key action that commands.json deliberately does not expose, with the reason. scripts/check-compat.sh (check 7) requires each action herdr's [keys] template lists to be either covered by commands.json or classified here, so a herdr release that adds an action turns the check red instead of silently widening the gap. Reasons: no-cli (no public herdr CLI achieves the same effect), by-design (excluded by docs/design/command-catalog.md), redundant (another catalog command already does it), not-an-action (a key definition, not an operation). An entry the template does not list is tolerated: the template is hand-written in herdr's src/main.rs and omits real fields (copy_mode, swap_pane_*).
